summary: Companion: SONEDE live payment adapter on the shared ClicToPay factory, off by default: offered and executable only while its one-shot marker is armed, every start (owner-confirmed local path included) consumes it, absent marker = blocked/payment_not_submitted.
reason: 06/11 Amine's SONEDE payment request was refused because no SONEDE payment contract existed. Live S24 discovery (no card, no payment) proved the provider-prepared ClicToPay session; the playbooks twin PR adds the provider adapter. The Companion must expose it without enabling any debit before the controlled recipe.

The SONEDE success return is not observed yet: a success is reconciled by the bank timeout path (60 s).
